workflows.title: Make the backlog actionable.
workflows.request: Review new issues. Group duplicates and identify what needs investigation.
workflows.plan: I’ll separate clear requests from missing context, then bring back a prioritised summary.
workflows.result: Triage report and proposed next steps

workflows.title: Fix the quota meter rounding.
workflows.request: The quota meter turns amber too early. Investigate the cause and prepare a fix.
workflows.plan: I’ll have one agent trace the calculation, another update the implementation, and a reviewer check the change.
workflows.result: Code change, tests and a pull-request draft

workflows.title: Give the release a second look.
workflows.request: Check the latest changes. Reproduce failures and report anything that needs attention.
workflows.plan: I’ll split the checks across specialists and collect the evidence in one review.
workflows.result: Test results and a review summary

workflows.title: Find the risk. Show the evidence.
workflows.request: Review this change for security issues. Explain the impact and suggest fixes.
workflows.plan: I’ll trace the changed paths, investigate potential weaknesses and review each finding.

workflows.title: Keep the guide in step with the code.
workflows.request: Update the setup guide for this change. Check every example against the implementation.
workflows.plan: I’ll compare the existing guide with the code, prepare the changes and ask a reviewer to check them.

skills.name: Code review
skills.description: Review changes against company standards. Return findings with evidence and suggested fixes.
skills.summary: Share a skill once. Make the same practices available to teams across the company.

profiles.name: Security reviewer
profiles.description: A saved role with its instructions, skills and access ready for the next task.
profiles.summary: Reuse specialist profiles across tasks. Keep each agent’s responsibilities and access clear.

accounts.name: Claude Code · Engineering
accounts.description: A connected account made available to the teams that need it. Usage draws on this account’s quota.
accounts.summary: Share access to connected accounts. Keep credentials and permissions managed in one place.

workspaces.name: Platform launch
workspaces.description: A shared place for the team’s sessions, files and agent work.
workspaces.summary: Give teammates access to a workspace so they can follow progress and work together.

artifacts.name: Release readiness report
artifacts.description: A report produced by the agent team, shared for review.
artifacts.summary: Share reports, prototypes and other artifacts with the people who need to review them.
